decisions.decision: The task board is the home for task status; git is the home for code and docs. Every task has both and they link to each other
decisions.why: a daily report built from git alone was out of date
decisions.reopen_when: the board and git disagree more than once a week

decisions.decision: The freelance marketplace is sales channel one; the professional network is channel two, later
decisions.why: one channel gets all proposal effort until it pays
decisions.reopen_when: cost per signed deal above 5% of deal value for a month

decisions.decision: The designer has no admin work; billing, client reports and board admin are the owner's
decisions.why: the designer first learns the main flows

decisions.decision: The designer reviews each change by testing it on the live test stage; no separate review step
decisions.why: a second review step slowed delivery and found less than a real test
decisions.reopen_when: a defect reaches production that a code review would have caught

decisions.decision: Heavy jobs and CI run on the build server, never on a laptop
decisions.reopen_when: the build server is down for more than a day

decisions.decision: Boosted listings on the marketplace: how many and what budget
decisions.why: the ads budget is not set
